name: FV_TR_TREAS_ACCOUNT_SYMBOLS
description: This table contains Treasury Account Symbols Information.

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Treasury Account Symbol.

columns.name: TREAS_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Budget Authority segment instance assigned to Treasury Symbol year of availability.

columns.name: FED_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL_ID
columns.description: Identifier for Federal Account Symbol.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the ledger.

columns.name: SUB_LEVEL_PREFIX_CODE
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that when populated, represents a programmatic breakdown of the account for Treasury publication purposes.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_TRANSFER_AGENCY
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that identifies the agency receiving funds through an allocation transfer.

columns.name: AUTHORITY_DURATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether a Treasury Account Symbol is an annual year account (A), multi-year account (M) or no-year account (X).

columns.name: BEG_YEAR_OF_AVAILABILITY
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that identifies the first year of availability under law that an account may incur new obligations, in annual and multiyear accounts.

columns.name: END_YEAR_OF_AVAILABILITY
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that identifies the last year of availability under law that an account may incur new obligations, in annual and multiyear accounts.

columns.name: AVAILABILITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that identifies no-year accounts (X), clearing/suspense accounts (F), Treasury central summary general ledger accounts (A), and merged-surplus accounts (M).

columns.name: SUB_ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: The Treasury Symbol component that Identifies an available receipt or other Treasury-defined subdivision of the main account.

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL
columns.description: The identification code assigned by Treasury, in collaboration with Office of Management and Budget and the owner agency, to an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account.

columns.name: FUND_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The  code that establishes how the Treasury Account Symbol will be funded.

columns.name: FINANCING_ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the Federal Account Symbol is a direct loan financing account, a guaranteed loan financing account, or is not a financing account as defined by the Federal Credit Reform Act of 1990.

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies a Treasury Account Symbols as Governmentwide Treasury Account Symbol reportable, Data Act reportable, or both.

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR_ADJUSTMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if a Treasury Account Symbol is subject to prior year accounting.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date when the Treasury Account Symbol is available for use.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Represents the date when a Treasury Account Symbol expires and is the last date an obligation can occur.

columns.name: CANCELLATION_DATE
columns.description: Represents the last date on which a fund may disbursed. For most funds, it is 5 years beyond the ending fiscal year of the period of availability unless specified otherwise in law.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date when the treasury symbol is no longer available for use.

columns.name: COPY_TREAS_ACC_SYMBOL_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if a the Treasury Account Symbol which will expire in the currently fiscal year should be copied with next year's fiscal year.
